disclaimer_short: Decision-support tool for rural users and ASHA workers. NOT a clinical diagnosis and does not prescribe medicine.

welcome.subtitle: Get clear guidance on whether to care for symptoms at home, visit your local Primary Health Centre (PHC), or seek emergency care immediately.
welcome.key_benefit_1: Emergency safety checks run offline in under 1 second
welcome.key_benefit_2: Vetted advice in Hindi, Marathi, and English

report.disclaimer_note: Values are compared ONLY against reference ranges printed on the report. SwasthaSathi does NOT diagnose illnesses.
report.range_not_found: Printed reference range not detected on report image.

about.title: About SwasthaSathi & Clinical Safety Design
about.mission: SwasthaSathi is an open AI decision-support platform designed to bridge the rural-urban healthcare divide in India.
about.safety_rule_1: 1. Deterministic offline safety rules override AI models every time.
about.safety_rule_2: 2. No diagnosis, no drug prescriptions, no tablet counts or dosing advice.
about.safety_rule_3: 3. The AI model can escalate risk level, but can NEVER lower a rule-based floor.
about.safety_rule_4: 4. All first-aid guidance comes from curated libraries by vetted ID.
about.disclaimer_box: IMPORTANT NOTICE: SwasthaSathi is a prototype decision-support tool created for the INNOVA X 2026 Hackathon. It does not replace professional medical diagnosis, treatment, or judgment by a qualified clinician.
